cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I waved goodbye when you did. Lovely to see our regular visitor. Did their coat get wet?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I waved at the postman. Our visitor's still washing their hands; they didn't bring a coat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, giving them a moment. Shall I put tea in the spare cup when they come back?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coffee, black. They only came to return your book.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Was there a gardening-club slip inside it? I'll put that beside the coffee.

reason: Make the mistaken copied greeting create the face-saving need to investigate a supposedly familiar visitor indirectly; each question now uses a disclosed circumstantial clue rather than a decorative cup posture.
